notes.title: Release 09-2025
notes.content:
[p]Welcome to a new release of DaVinCo.
 
In this release, we have updated a significant portion of our internal code in preparation for some upcoming features.[/p][p]We added a new feature for real-time streaming of USD files, textures, and mesh data over network connections into DaVinCo. While the feature is experimental for now (you can enable it in the Settings), this will become a permanent feature in the next release. For more information, take a look at our [url="https://github.com/FZJ-JSC/jusync"]GitHub Repository[/url].[/p][p]Have fun using DaVinCo![/p]

notes.title: Release 07-2024
notes.content:
Welcome to a new release of DaVinCo.

In this release, we updated to Unreal Engine 5. 
While functionality has remained largely the same, you can expect increased performance and stability overall.

Changelog:
[list]
    [*] Upgrade to Unreal Engine 5
    [*] Improved lighting in levels
    [*] Improved controls in VR
    [*] Improved user interface: We gave the menu for hosting a session an improved look and cleaned it up. In addition, the color scheme in the menus are more consistent now.
    [*] Fixed a bug that caused large amounts of memory being used with larger models
    [*] Fixed a bug that caused models to previously sometimes spawn off-center or wrongly scaled
    [*] Various bugfixes around spawning and destroying of players and models
    [*] General improvement of stability
[/list]

Have fun using DaVinCo!
